_comment: The starter inventory taxonomy a fresh database gets (app/starter.py): one row per Item Category with the Group the Inventory pages flip through and two descriptive lists — Subcategory (what the category tends to hold) and Classification (Apparel | Accessory | Technology | Equipment | Furniture | Home Goods | Kitchen Equipment | Media | Consumable | Supply | Asset). Neither list cascades onto Items. Edit freely on the Categories page afterwards; this file is read once, when the table is empty.
